description:
## 1.39.1-rokid.3 (2026-10-07)

Morphe dialogs now work with the glasses touchpad and the R08 ring. The first-launch "Restart required" dialog can be confirmed with a touchpad click instead of leaving the user stuck, Back no longer dismisses dialogs that are meant to stay open, and the first key after a dialog closes goes back to the Rokid controls.
